description: Explain one abaplint rule in depth: title, description, extended rationale (often citing the Clean ABAP style guide), tags, documentation URL, and good/bad code examples where the rule defines them. Use this when a lint_abap or check_cloud_readiness finding needs justification — to explain to a developer why the finding matters and how to fix it. It does not run analysis and only knows abaplint rules; SAP ATC check documentation is out of scope. Example: explain_abap_rule({ "rule": "exit_or_check" }).

rule.description: The abaplint rule key from a finding, e.g. "exit_or_check" or "obsolete_statement".

name: explain_abap_rule

badExample.description: Code the rule flags, if the rule ships an example.

extendedInformation.description: Extended rationale; may cite Clean ABAP.

goodExample.description: The compliant version, if the rule ships one.

title: Explain an abaplint rule
